rule: Internal codes (T1, L0, …) NEVER change — validators, gates, ledgers, packs, lingua, treeka and the essay compiler all key on them. Public names are ADDITIVE: surfaces may present {code, public} together, and accept either on input. A bare rename of codes requires a major schema version + migration, never a quiet edit.

layers.label: Source text
layers.blurb: The sha-pinned Sanskrit bytes (GRETIL/Muktabodha edition). Never translated, only cited.
layers.comment: Personal: 'bytes beat claims' — upstream typos go upstream, never silently emended.

layers.label: Draft translation
layers.blurb: Lore-primed fast pass: verse draft plus a quick gloss per token. Coverage before sharpness.
layers.comment: Personal: 'the fast pass' — every pada faced before anything sharp is attempted; revised only by L0, with a flag.

layers.label: Literal gloss
layers.blurb: Term-by-term scholarly audit: every genuine meaning-fork as a ranked option with grammatical grounds and a source.
layers.comment: Personal: 'the options layer' — forks live HERE and nowhere else; chosen == T1 gloss unless revised with reason.

layers.label: Argument map
layers.blurb: What the verse says as a whole: speaker, question, premises, inference, payoff, uncertainties. Adjudicates L0 forks on the record.
layers.comment: Personal: 'reads the verse as a whole' against Sanskrit+T1+L0+scholarship; terse logical statements, no certainty labels.

layers.label: Reading translation
layers.blurb: Our translation proper: readable line-by-line plain English, every clause tracing to literal-gloss ids, Sanskrit cite byte-exact.
layers.comment: Personal: 'rasa in word choice, not decoration' — words must evoke, not just convey; supplied[] logs bracketed insertions.

layers.label: Essence
layers.blurb: The subtle essence: the sharpest poetic reading of what the verse DOES (rasa/camatkara), plus the standard 7-part essay.
layers.comment: Personal: 'states the MATTERS, never the document' — no quoted gloss-words, no metacommentary, zero shared sentences with L2.

layers.label: Register render
layers.blurb: A register rendering (eli5, genz, poetic, formal…) over essence + final-translation: style plus reproducing prompt, model/date, paragraphs mapped.
layers.comment: Personal: 'a new reading is just a prompt away' — unmapped paragraphs rejected; reproducibility is the contract.

layers.label: Final translation
layers.blurb: One translation to look at: line-by-line evocative verse tracing to literal-gloss + essence. Frozen once loved.
layers.comment: Personal: 'frozen once loved' — musical work lives in L4, never in L3 edits; no slashes, exact diacritics.

layers.label: Song
layers.blurb: The final translation set to music: prosody, rhythm, rhyme — parses as song when read aloud. Requires L3.
layers.comment: Personal: 'music, never doctrine' — traces are a SUBSET of L3's; a rhyme needing a new slant fails.
